paragraflar: In many places, kisses are used hello. If you are in Europe or South America, you will see lots of these greeting kisses. But the kissing customs for greeting people are from country to country, and traveling to new places can be confusing if don't know them. Many European men and women say hello with two kisses, one on each cheek. But three kisses are polite in Belgium, and young people in Paris often prefer four, in these countries, you must the right cheek. Starting with your left cheek would be as awkward as sticking out your left hand for a handshake. A variation on the cheek kiss is found in Brazil. When women meet, they put their cheeks together and kiss the air. In some, men kiss each other on the cheeks at business meetings. It's like saying hands. In some parts of the world, people don't kiss when they meet each other. In fact, kissing in public is considered polite In Japan and China, for example, people in public places rarely kiss each other, In most Middle Eastern countries, men and women do not kiss in public, either.

Kisses aren't just for saying hello; people kiss for lots of other reasons as well. For example, a kiss can also of respect. Some people show respect by kissing religious articles and plans Others kiss the ground when they come home to a country they love. Europeans and Latin Americans also use kisses to say beautiful\! They kiss their fingertips when they see a pretty woman, an expensive car, or a great soccer play. In other places, people say good- bye by kissing their fingertips and blowing the kiss away. Kisses are associated with, too. The French started the custom of kissing their words for good luck before playing. and today, some people kiss a pair of dice before they role them. The English kisses hurt fingers to make them better, as do today. And, of course, people also kiss to make up after a fight.

What are the customs for kissing people in your country? Do you kiss your relatives when you visit them? Do you kiss your friends hello when? Is it polite to kiss someone in public places in your country? All of these kissing customs depend on where in the world you are. Kissing may seem as universal as language, but in fact, kissing customs differ around the world.
